source_audit.draw_path: robots.present -> present_actor matches Maybe Robot; draw snapshots carry &[Maybe Robot].
source_audit.small_natural_fixture: ../gdev/tests/robot_flight.blot:97; flying pose and five-case save/load entries. All entries compile together in this probe.
source_audit.admission_boundary: stableDescriptorShape rejects variants on descriptor reader/writer paths. The separate reusableInlineCall path uses plainInlineValue, which does not reject variant_tags; variant helper reuse is not universally disabled.
source_audit.conclusion: Natural variant fixture still exceeds five seconds. No evidence yet that variants explain costly helper-sharing misses.

next_measurement: First remeasure the diagnostic demand inventory without blanket initializer/attribute roots: existing runtime semantics are lazy for unreachable declarations. Keep associated/operator/implementation seeds conservative and exhaustive checking mandatory. Separately count unchanged substitution copies on a bounded completed producer; preserve per-use fresh covariant rows and exact callback requirements.
limits: No current whole-game Wasm size, one-second build, 1 MB validation or fresh frame. Existing gate failure and release qualification status are unchanged.

followup_local_inspection.method: Second debugger run: interrupt after 3s, set openCovariant entry and root-publication breakpoints, resume for at most one second, then quit. Debugger overhead is substantial; this is not an exhaustive count or a time comparison.
limits: Only two root-publication observations. One changed generic function created five nodes; one no-op function publication had four memo entries. Neither proves dominant cost.
A non-projected invariant leaf can return before the observed publication, so this sample cannot estimate the no-op fraction of all openings.
